verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents submitting tasks through the API, running batches and async jobs, chat sessions, and auditable research conclusions. Nothing shows versioning, review workflows, or rollback for user-defined automations. Tracing findings back to code or literature is about auditing outputs, and recovering an expired chat session is not rolling back an automation, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
